entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Thanks for everything, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
And
you
too, Clive...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_01

entries.text: I’m glad I could see this through to the end.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_01

entries.text: I guess this is it for Team Star...and me, too—[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_02

entries.text: Hold that thought, Mis— Ah...Penny! I’d like to\ncheck something with you first.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_02

entries.text: Check...what?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_03

entries.text: Why resort to something like Operation Starfall\nif you’re the big boss of Team Star?\c\nWasn’t there any other way to handle this?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_03

entries.text: I tried telling the bosses that we were done once\nbefore. But they still didn’t quit...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_04

entries.text: Why not simply order them to?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_04

entries.text: Our code states that no one in the team has the\nright to order people around. I could ask them\r\nall to do stuff, but I could never order them.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_05

entries.text: So, it’s back to the code once again... The bosses\nmust’ve taken it very seriously.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_05

entries.text: They did. That’s why I knew I could use it to force\nTeam Star to disband.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_06

entries.text: Because the bosses would do anything the code\nrequired of them? Even leave the team?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_06

entries.text: Yes... And according to the code, they had to\naccept any challenge made to them.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_07

entries.text: Thus the idea for Operation Starfall...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_07

entries.text: Cassiopeia. Let me ask you one last thing.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_08

entries.text: What does Team Star— No, what do your friends\nin the team mean to you?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_09

entries.text: They’re my greatest treasure.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_09

entries.text: Splendid. Thank you for apprising me of the\nsituation, Miss Penny.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_10

entries.text: Now, young lady, there’s something I should very\nmuch like to discuss with you.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_11

entries.text: Hey, quit it with the old geezer act, Clive!\nYou’re creeping me out...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_11

entries.text: ...Indeed. Well then, before we talk further, allow\nme to reveal to you my own secret identity![VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_12

entries.text: Ha-hah![VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_13

entries.text: D-Director Clavell?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_12

entries.text: Just as Cassiopeia was your disguise, the boy\nyou knew as Clive was mine![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_14

entries.text: But... But why?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_13

entries.text: [EMPTY 32]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_15

entries.text: I needed a way to talk to Team Star on\nequal terms.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_16

entries.text: Students do tend to shy from speaking their mind\nto their teachers, after all... Much more so when\r\nfaced with the director of the academy.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_17

entries.text: Yeah, but...where do I even start? Wasn’t the\noutfit a bit much?\c\nPlus I have some big feelings about that wig...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0150_botan_14

entries.text: Ahem! Well, that’s quite enough of that for now.\c\nEveryone! Why don’t you come on out?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0150_nelke_18
